scheme_name: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years
Applicant must have adequate water facilities for setting up the unit
Applicant must have own or leased land adequate to set up an ornamental unit
Applicant must have undergone a training programme on Ornamental Fish Farming organized by the Fisheries Department, MPEDA, or ICAR
benefits_summary: Provides 50% financial assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for setting up a breeding or rearing unit, or up to ₹2,50,000 for setting up both units.
